text: When you're ready to bring people in, open the project's Manage tab and choose Share project.
Invite someone by email, and choose whether they can view the project or edit it with you.
Everyone with access is listed here, and you can change what they can do, or remove them, at any time.
Or turn on a link that anyone can open to view it, with no account needed.
Whoever opens it sees the project as you've set it out: the cover, the story and the production details.
Everyone you invite sees changes as they happen, and the project keeps track of who did what.
